title: Spondylolysis and spondylolisthesis in the athlete.

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Spondylolysis and spondylolisthesis are common causes of back and leg pain in the athletic population. Spondylolysis originates most often in children between 5 and 10 years of age. Many types of athletic activities requiring lumbar extension and rotation place the immature spine at risk for developing these lesions.
